user_story: As a user, I want the login endpoint to return an error when the email field is empty so that I provide all required credentials.

positive.title: Login with valid email and password
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with a valid email and password in the payload.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and receives a success response with a token.

negative.title: Login with an empty email field
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with an empty email field and a valid password in the payload.
negative.expected_result: An error is returned indicating that the email field cannot be empty.

edge.title: Login with whitespace as email field
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with a whitespace string as the email field and a valid password in the payload.
edge.expected_result: An error is returned indicating that the email field cannot be empty or consist only of whitespace.
